newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan MITI sees July-Sept output up 1.1% qtr/qtr.
newsitem.headline: Japan MITI sees July-Sept output up 1.1% qtr/qtr.

text.p: The Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) expects Japan's industrial production for the July-September quarter to have risen 1.1 percent from the previous quarter and 3.4 percent from the same period a year earlier, a ministry official said on Thursday.
The ministry had previously forecast that industrial production in the quarter would rise 1.5 percent quarter-on-quarter and 3.7 percent year-on-year.
"We have not changed our view that industrial production is still gradually recovering," the MITI official told reporters.
She added that there had been no dramatic change in inventory adjustments.
